entries.prompt: Production transparent PNG animation sheet, EXACTLY TWO columns and TWO rows, FOUR equal SQUARE cells. Match the reference object exactly, same soft painted fantasy material and design. Full tall decoration in EVERY cell, same roots/base location, same rock/rigid trunk proportions and scale, fixed camera, NO whole object translation, resizing, rotation, opacity flashing. Object plus effects occupies only 60-65% of each cell, centered with very generous transparent gutters so no leaf or droplet crosses a cell boundary. Animate a growing breathing aquatic beanstalk: four successive loop poses of the top curled tendril unfurling and curling, leaves gently bending at their stems in the current, large dew drops leaving lower leaves and drifting upward to upper leaves, then new drops gathering. Keep roots and main woody spiral trunk absolutely identical and fixed across all poses. Real anatomical leaf/tendril deformation, not only glow. No borders, labels, cell outlines, words, checkerboard, background or additional objects. Actual alpha transparency. Smooth loop top-left top-right bottom-left bottom-right.
